rollout_revisions.name: A
rollout_revisions.description: Revision A warning release: the security_posture knob is admitted with default permissive, every manager reports the posture it runs in, and every operation under permissive warns security_posture_permissive once; shipped first

rollout_revisions.name: B
rollout_revisions.description: Revision B flip release: the security_posture default flips to hardened; an explicit permissive keeps restoring today's per-knob defaults with the warning

profile_note: The profile never invents allowlist entries: under either posture an absent allowlist is still empty. Under hardened the empties are refused (profile_refusals); under permissive they permit all with the documented warnings.
scope_notes: The routine per-query unreachable-registry warning of registry section 4 carries no code and is unchanged; only the install/update gate notice is a vector surface.

The mcp_package_allowlist_empty section 12 status-row rendering stays in vectors/environments-env-passthrough.json; this family pins the hardened error escalation and the status-check currency verdict.

Both status commands carry the same closed inventory: curator_status_rows and env_status_rows are the header row plus the thirteen status_gates in order. A schema-1 machine has no environments object: curator_status_rows is bounded to the header row plus the four schema1_gates, env_status_rows is null, and the effective set carries no environments keys.

execution_binding.surface: manager configuration resolution and read-only status: the effective profile, the effective values with provenance, the operation diagnostics and outcome, and the security_posture rows
execution_binding.spec_gate: structural only: tools/validate.py validate_security_posture_vectors recomputes the profile, effective values, diagnostics, outcome, and rows of every case from the case inputs; it does not run a manager
execution_binding.downstream_note: TASK-260910-1sapuy owns the install-time unreachable-registry notice; the effective defaults and the posture rows are owned by the manager posture work
